verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents its own web client. It lists Web among supported platforms, lets you host the web client on your own server and domain, and says 1.5.0 adds WebRTC paths that enable direct access from the web client. This is first-party support for browser-based remote access. However, the evidence never states that full view and control works from the browser, that nothing at all must be installed, or what limits the web client has, and no community or hands-on report confirms it. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the browser client provides full view and control with zero installation, documented web-client feature parity and limitations, independent or hands-on corroboration of browser sessions.

support.subject: As a power user, someone can view or control a session from a plain browser with nothing installed

citations.quote: Host the web client on your server with your domain name to make remote access even easier.
Works on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Web.
RustDesk 1.5.0 adds WebRTC connection paths, enables direct access from the web client
